id.description: Id of the {@link ReliabilityMetric}. Will be associated with the {@link ReliabilityMetric} during edit or delete.

createdBy.description: The user who created this {@link ReliabilityMetric}.

description.description:
The detailed description of how to uses the {@link ReliabilityMetric}. This is how the
user understands which arguements can be placed within the call.

permission.description:
The permission that has been assigned to this {@link ReliabilityMetric}.
Indicates whther the {@link ReliabilityMetric} can be shared or not.

expandedExpression.description: The expanded expression of the metric, which is used for metric calculations.

assets.description: A list of related assets that this {@link ReliabilityMetric} is associated with.

facility.description: The {@link Facility} associated with this {@link ReliabilityMetric}.

lastUpdated.description: Get the time at which the custom metric was updated.

title:
A Spec type that holds the information related to a {@link ReliabilityMetric} that has been
created or modified by a user in the UI.
name: ReliabilityMetricSpec
